svg.title: App hosting platforms with managed Postgres compared (2026)
svg.desc: Seven app hosting platforms sorted into two groups: four that run the app and a managed Postgres database in one project, and three where the database and the app host are two products. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: Seven ways to run an app next to managed Postgres, priced and dated
App and Postgres in one project
one plan, one region, one repo
